nom: QUIA Toner Pads for Sensitive Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin say it removes excess oil and helps with clogged pores quickly, though one cautions using it daily can tip her sensitive, oily skin toward feeling too dry, so she limits use to about once a day or skips some days.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports instant hydration and more refined-looking pores after cleansing with a pad; two other reviews report the pads left skin feeling quite dry despite moisturizing afterward, one following a hives-causing allergic reaction to an ingredient.
segments.combination: One reviewer who describes her skin as very oily yet dry, with visible pores and blackheads, says the pads removed a surprising amount of oil and dirt and seemed to tighten her pores slightly, without additional dryness.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no burning, stinging, redness or irritation, and several note visible pore refinement and fewer blackheads within one to a few weeks; one reviewer had a severe allergic reaction (hives, followed by several days of dry, reactive skin) to a specific ingredient not listed on the product page.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin who had never broken out from any product in 40-plus years says she broke out after using these pads; another describes it as great for normal or sensitive skin with zero redness or purging.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the pads hydrate without drying out the skin, with several noting instantly softer or more hydrated skin after a single use; two dissenting reviews report their skin felt quite dry afterward despite following with a moisturizer, and one needs to limit use to once a day to avoid her skin turning too dry.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no redness after use, including with regular exfoliating use; no reviewer in this set reports the pads causing redness, though one had a hives reaction to a specific ingredient.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer highlights that the formula includes an ingredient meant to strengthen the skin barrier; by contrast, another reviewer had an allergic reaction to a different ingredient that left her skin dry and unable to tolerate her normal products for several days afterward.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the AHA/BHA formula helped reduce dark spots along with blackheads and texture, without irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer blackheads and clearer, less congested pores within about a week of use, and a couple say it helps head off breakouts before they form; one dissenting review noticed a couple of small pimples she doesn't usually get after starting to use the pads.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say the pads remove a significant amount of excess oil without leaving a tacky or oily residue; one cautions that daily use can over-correct and make her skin feel too dry, so she uses it only about once a day.

aspects.libelle: Packaging sometimes arrives moldy or water-damaged
Pads stay generously soaked, don't dry out
Expensive for the number of pads
Ingredient list doesn't match PHA marketing claim

extraits.titre: Disappointed due to break out on my normal skin.
extraits.texte: I seen no changes after a few uses. I do not have sensitive skin. I have normal skin and have used many different products from a variety of brands and never have I broken out in the 40 plus years. This is the first product I have ever used that claims its been tested to work for even sensitive skin (which i don't have sensitive skin, I have normal skin), and have broken out. I am very disappointed.

extraits.titre: Ingredients list needs to be on the product page
extraits.texte: I'm disappointed in these Ouia toner pads, because upon receiving them, I spotted an ingredient that my skin is highly allergic to as one of the top ingredients, 1, 2 Hexanediol. It gives me hives, followed by several days of dry, sensitive skin that can't even tolerate the normal products I use after using a product containing this ingredient. If the manufacturer had simply listed the ingredients, then I could have avoided ordering this product. I also noticed a couple of other ingredients that are potential triggers for others with allergies. I'm not sure how this is being marketed as being good for sensitive skin. For people who do not have any issues with questionable ingredients, my observations are: -The pads have no scent. -They are nice and wet with product. -The actual pad has the back side with a more coarse, exfoliating texture, and the front of the pad is made of soft cotton. I have pads from another company that are similar to these, and I really love the dual function of these. Basically, the back side gets used first, and it cleans away dead skin, leftover particles, or makeup, and anything else that shouldn't be there. Then, after wiping the face well with the exfoliating side, turn the pad over and wipe the soft side all over. It makes the skin very clean, and it's also really soothing. -The packaging is of nice quality. At the time of this review, the price is $39.99 for a pack of 70 pads. If used once a day, then it's a supply for more than two months. That

extraits.titre: Some Good KBeauty Pads That Seem To Deliver On Their Advertisements And Statements
extraits.texte: As someone who has always struggled with highly visible pores, blackheads, inflamed hair follicles, and very oily yet dry skin, I thought that this would be worth a try to see if it could help. I've tried most of the US-based name brands without a whole lot of luck, so I figured "why not?". The first thing that I noticed unpacking these is that the packaging is very nice. It's pleasant coloring and materials. The container for the wipes is really top notch - it includes a secondary seal to place over the wipes to help keep them from drying out. It also included a little clear set of tweezers to get the wipes out of the jar so I'm not digging in there with my finger and contaminating them. I felt like that was pretty thoughtful. When I removed the safety seal and the 2nd seal, I discovered that they aren't lying - they really are pretty drenched in the solution the pads are soaked in. That 2nd seal should help keep that being the case. There are a couple of drying/potential irritation agents in these like salicylic acid and lactic acid, so I was curious to see if they'd dry my skin out further at all, but it appears there are also enough offsetting ingredients in here to keep that from happening. The wipes removed an extraordinary amount of oil and dirt from my face - I really didn't like thinking that was all on there, but that also means they are absolutely doing their job. I also did feel like maybe it did tighten up/close my pores a little bit. I didn't experience any burn

extraits.titre: Smoothing results quickly but also quite drying
extraits.texte: These PHA toner pads are double-sided with an exfoliating side to be used first, followed by the embossed, gentle side. After a couple nights of consecutive use, my face looked especially smooth but also felt quite dry, despite following the toner pads with moisturizer, as directed. I had started with once-daily use, though the directions call for twice-daily use. I'd like to build up to that frequency, if possible, but I need to start with once-every-other-night use and drench my face with moisture afterward.

extraits.titre: Helps me with clogged pores and oily skin.
extraits.texte: The Quia Toner Pads are great for me because I am always on the go, and they are super easy to apply at home, or even take them with me when I feel that my skin may break out. They cool and hydrate my skin with just one pad, and I can see them working effectively right away and getting rid of any excess oil. I do have sensitive skin, so I have to balance and pay attention when using them so that my skin is not too dry or too oily. And for that reason, quite often it is better to just use one pad a day, and perhaps on some days skip them altogether to keep that balance. Overall, I like that they do not have negative effects on my skin. When I feel my skin feeling irritated, this is what I go to first to help prevent a breakout, and it does help a lot. These pads help hydrate my skin while at the same time helping me with clogged pores. I do see a difference with smoother and more vibrant skin as well. For what I got, this is a great overall value.

extraits.titre: Effective and Gentle, Minor Packaging Issue
extraits.texte: These toner pads from QUIA are very effective yet gentle on sensitive skin. The AHA/BHA formula exfoliates while hydrating, helping reduce blackheads, texture, and dark spots without irritation. The pads are soft, well-soaked, and soothing, making them easy to use daily. However, the product packaging arrived slightly damp, which did not affect the pads or performance but is worth noting. Overall, a great all-in-one skincare product with excellent results.

I’m new to toner pads, and I was pleasantly surprised by how practical and easy these are to use. I have dry skin, and I used one right after cleansing. My skin felt instantly hydrated, and my pores looked more refined. I also really appreciate that the pads come in a sealed container and include a spatula, which makes them more hygienic and convenient.
